retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, sun-drenched portrait featuring a central figure obscured by intense golden lens flares and overexposed highlights.
triggerTerms: warm high-key photography with minimalist sans-serif type
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition dominated by a central hooded figure bathed in extreme, overexposed warm light. The light source creates a massive, soft-edged white and yellow flare that washes out the subject's facial features, leaving only a suggestion of the eyes and nose. The background is a flat, off-white cream color, creating a high-key aesthetic where the subject emerges from the bottom frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-light: The light acts as both a mask and a highlight, obscuring the face.
Warmth-to-Neutral: The golden-orange tones of the figure contrast against a sterile cream background.
Scale-to-Space: Large-scale display typography at the top balances the weighted figure at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Extreme overexposure in the center of the frame
Minimalist off-white negative space at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central hooded figure, cropped from the chest up, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intense white-hot center of the lens flare on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text at the top, drops down to the bright flare, and settles on the subtle secondary text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cream-colored negative space in the top third and around the shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background providing a clean, high-key base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and orange tones within the subject and flare.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white highlights at the core of the light flare.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout; saturation is concentrated in the mid-tones of the hoodie and the edges of the flare.
paletteRestrictions: No deep blacks or heavy shadows

composition.scale: Large, spanning the width of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family pairing using weight and scale contrast (Bold vs. Light).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric uppercase structure and uniform weight.
Provides a similar modern, clean aesthetic with open counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a hooded figure from the chest up against a cream background. Apply an intense, overexposed golden-yellow lens flare directly over the face, washing out features into white light. Keep the bottom edges of the figure visible in warm orange tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in a muted gold color at the very top edge. Add small, light-weight, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white at the bottom right corner, tracked wide.

verificationChecks: Is the face significantly obscured by light?
Is the background a flat, warm off-white?
Is the top text bold and uppercase?
Is the overall color palette limited to warm tones and cream?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the warm light (yellow vs. orange)
mustRedesign: Do not include specific facial features if they are too clear; maintain the overexposed 'wash out' effect.
Do not use cool colors like blue or green.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the flare doesn't look like a solid white circle but a natural light bleed.
Ensure the top text is perfectly centered and aligned to the top margin.
Verify the bottom right text is legible but subtle against the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key overexposed portrait + central lens flare + top-aligned geometric sans-serif display type + warm monochromatic palette.
